{{Quote|Slumming, ''uptown?'' Come down to visit the scum?|Frazznik, to Zayne Carrick|<ref name="kotor3" />}}
'''Frazznik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] who lived on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the era of the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. A member of the [[Lower City]] [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] gang known as the [[Black Vulkars/Legends|Black Vulkars]], Frazznik worked under the Vulkar leader [[Benno]] along with his friend and constant companion, the hulking [[Drovian]] [[Wargo]]. In [[3964 BBY]], Frazznik and Wargo were two of the first to find wanted fugitives [[Zayne Carrick]] and [[Marn Hierogryph]] in the Lower City, but were convinced to let them go in exchange for a tip from Hierogryph on a place to find some hidden [[Spice/Legends|spice]]&mdash;a hint that turned out to be a lie and earned the two Vulkars a beating from some [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]]. After the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] [[Taris Siege|laid siege]] to Taris in one of the early campaigns of the Mandalorian Wars, Frazznik and Wargo abandoned Taris and signed up with the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusader]] army. The pair were sent to a staging point on the ice world [[Jebble]] in advance of a planned Mandalorian invasion of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], but were eventually [[Death/Legends|killed]] after an outbreak of the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]] destroyed the Mandalorians gathered on Jebble.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I see the colors&mdash;you're with the Vulkars. Benno's boys, maybe?"<br />"What's it to you, side dish?"<br />"Benno hates to wait. Cashing a bounty from the Constable's gonna mean bureaucracy, authorizations, delay&mdash;and they may make him come up-city to testify. Just picture ''Benno, up-city!''"<br />"''Hrrmm.'' Benno don't like to wear city clothes."<br />"And that'd be for weeks at a time! And all he's gonna be thinking about is the guys who ''got'' him there."<br />"Benno don't ''like'' thinking!|Marn Hierogryph and Frazznik|<ref name="kotor3" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]], Frazznik was a member of the notorious [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] gang known as the [[Black Vulkars/Legends|Black Vulkars]], who were active in the [[Lower City]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the era of the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. By [[3964 BBY]], Frazznik worked for the Vulkar leader known as [[Benno]], and was often seen with his [[Drovian]] friend and fellow Vulkar [[Wargo]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the graduating class of the [[Jedi Tower]] in the [[Upper City]] was [[Padawan Massacre|murdered]], and blame fell on surviving [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Zayne Carrick]] and [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] criminal [[Marn Hierogryph]], who became highly wanted fugitives. The pair fled into the Lower City, where Frazznik and Wargo happened across the pair as they attempted to flee from justice. Frazznik initially targeted Carrick for a mugging because of his Upper City clothes, but Wargo recognized the two outsiders from their wanted [[Hologram/Legends|holos]], and the pair prepared to take the two to Benno to cash in on their lucrative [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]]. However, playing off Frazznik's fear of Benno's anger at having to deal with Upper City bureaucracy in order to complete the process of turning in the fugitives, Hierogryph managed to convince Frazznik to let them go by promising Frazznik a different, more lucrative score.<ref name="kotor3" />

Hierogryph pointed Frazznik and Wargo to a group of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] running a nearby trash cart, alleging that they had sewn stashes of illegal [[Spice/Legends|spice]] into their pack animal's harness. In truth, this was a lie made up by Hierogryph on the spot, but Frazznik and Wargo fell for the trick, and went off to steal the purported spice.<ref name="kotor3" /> The shakedown didn't go well for Frazznik and Wargo, as the Wookiees beat them badly, costing Frazznik's Drovian friend several [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]].<ref name="kotor26">[[Knights of the Old Republic 26|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 26]]</ref> Soon after the incident, the rampaging army known as the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] invaded and [[Taris Siege|besieged]] Taris as one of the main early offensives of their nascent war with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]&mdash;unlike many of the swoop gangs on Taris,<ref name="kotor22">[[Knights of the Old Republic 22|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 22]]</ref> Frazznik and Wargo elected to join the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] instead of fighting against them, and were sent to a staging point on the ice world of [[Jebble]] along with thousands of other new recruits from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. Frazznik thus became part of a rapidly expanding Mandalorian army that was aiming at greater conquests toward [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy's]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]].<ref name="kotor26" />

During their introduction to the Mandalorian ranks, Frazznik and Wargo were confronted with a pair of familiar faces: Carrick and Hierogryph, who had found their way to Jebble after stowing away on a Mandalorian [[Mar'eyce|ship]] coming from Taris. Wargo was beaten by a Mandalorian [[Rally Master]] after attempting to assault Hierogryph, and afterward, Frazznik and his friend learned their purpose for being on Jebble: to prepare for an assault on one of the Republic's crown jewels, the peaceful Core planet of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="kotor27" /> That invasion would never come to pass, as the ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] artifact known as the [[Muur Talisman]]&mdash;which had been brought to Jebble from Taris on the same ship that transported Carrick and Hierogryph&mdash;began to wreak its dark influence on the Mandalorian world, turning many warriors into the diseased mutants known as [[rakghoul]]s. Frazznik and Wargo, who were familiar with rakghouls from their presence on Taris, attempted to rally their new comrades-in-arms against the monsters. However, they were powerless to stop the mutants from sweeping through the remaining uninfected Mandalorians,<ref name="kotor27" /> and soon afterward Mandalorian strategist [[Cassus Fett]] laid waste to Jebble with a round of [[Nuclear weapon/Legends|nuclear bombs]].<ref name="kotor28">[[Knights of the Old Republic 28|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 28]]</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You're about to make my month, little cuss. The kick be comin' right to our turf.|Frazznik, to Zayne Carrick|<ref name="kotor3" />}}
While his friend Wargo was the muscle of the pair, the comparatively lithe [[Knife/Legends|knife]]-wielding Zabrak Frazznik was the talker, and had a tendency to refer to targets like Zayne Carrick as "little cuss." Frazznik had a great deal of fear and respect for his boss in the Black Vulkars, Benno, and was willing to give up major paydays in order to avoid his ire. Although he was an active member of the Black Vulkars,<ref name="kotor3" /> Frazznik held no special loyalty to the gang or the planet Taris, as he abandoned them to serve with the Mandalorians after the warriors invaded the planet.<ref name="kotor26" /> Frazznik had [[Color/Legends|red]] skin, white horns on his head and white [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="kotor3" />

==Behind the scenes==
Frazznik first appeared in [[Knights of the Old Republic 3|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 3]], the third installment of the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series, written by [[John Jackson Miller]] and released in [[2006]].<ref name="kotor3" /> Frazznik later appeared in [[Knights of the Old Republic 26|two]] [[Knights of the Old Republic 27|issues]] in the [[2008]] story arc ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Vector]]''.<ref name="kotor26" /><ref name="kotor27" /> In his comic appearances, Frazznik was illustrated by [[Brian Ching]]<ref name="kotor3" /> and [[Scott Hepburn]].<ref name="kotor26" /> According to Miller, Frazznik was originally intended to appear in one of ''[[The Adjudicator]]'' in-universe news items that were featured in several ''Knights of the Old Republic'' issues, but had to be cut for space.<ref name="jjm">{{Faraway|url=comics/swknights/swkotor26.html|text=''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic #26''}}</ref>
